resources.string: Tolerance reads social media posts to score them for manipulation tactics and progressively blurs manipulative content. It only accesses content from supported social media apps.

Tolerance analyzes posts in your social media feeds for psychological manipulation tactics like outrage bait, curiosity gaps, and tribal triggers.\n\nManipulative content gets progressively blurred the longer you scroll, helping you break free from doom-scrolling.

Tolerance needs accessibility access to read post content from social media apps. It only reads from Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, and Instagram.\n\nNo data is stored on any server. Scoring happens via OpenRouter API and results are cached locally.
Blur everything above score 20 (show only genuine content)
Entering reduced phase — high-engagement content now blurred
Wind-down phase — more content blurred, consider taking a break
Minimal phase — most manipulative content is blurred
